title: N-able Drives Business Resilience Across Australia Through Partnership with Leader

body_markdown:
*Helping businesses reduce cyber risk, minimise disruption, and maintain continuity*


**Sydney, Australia – September 23, 2026** –[N-able, Inc.](https://www.n-able.com/) (NYSE: NABL), a global cybersecurity company delivering business resilience, today announced a partnership with[Leader](https://leadersystems.com.au/) , a key distribution partner in Australia. Managed service providers (MSPs), resellers, systems integrators, and channel partners nationwide will gain access to the N‑able security portfolio through Leader’s established distribution network, along with local expert support and dedicated partner programs.


The partnership comes at a key time for the Australian market, as organisations face heightened cyber risk and growing pressure to strengthen preparedness, maintain critical services, and recover quickly from disruption. With AI increasing the speed and scale of attacks, businesses need integrated security capabilities that help reduce risk and build greater operational resilience.


“Australian MSPs and resellers need technology that can help them respond to evolving security challenges while supporting long-term growth,” said Hanh Tran, Cloud Business Manager at Leader. “By bringing N‑able’s portfolio to our partner network, we’re giving them greater choice, backed by the local expertise, enablement, and support they need to deliver stronger outcomes for their customers.”


The partnership builds on N‑able’s continued investment and innovation in Australia. By embedding AI and integrated security capabilities into the tools businesses use every day, N‑able helps automate routine tasks, streamline workflows, and build greater security outcomes while keeping people firmly in control. Recent innovations include[Cove Disaster Recovery as a Service (DRaaS)](https://www.n-able.com/products/cove-data-protection/disaster-recovery/draas) , designed to help organisations simplify disaster recovery planning, validate recovery readiness, and recover critical systems and data quickly to minimise downtime and maintain business continuity.


“Organisations increasingly rely on trusted technology partners to help them navigate a complex threat landscape before, during, and after an attack,” said Neil Morarji, Regional Vice President, APAC at N-able. “Our partnership with Leader will make it easier for partners to provide that support, expand their services, and build secure, profitable businesses for the long term.”


For more information, visit[www.n-able.com](https://www.n-able.com/)


**About N-able**


N-able protects businesses from evolving cyberthreats. Our AI powered cybersecurity platform delivers business resilience to more than 500,000 organizations worldwide, leveraging advanced end-to-end capabilities, simplified workflows, market leading integrations, and flexible deployment options to improve efficiency and drive critical security outcomes. Our partner first approach pairs our technology with experts, training, and peer-led events that empower customers to be secure, resilient, and successful. n-able.com
